Name: DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]finally made an interior recolour to match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolour[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]Earthy Interface[/url] mods~



[img]https://i.imgur.com/FlWVxfK.png[/img]﻿

⋆ recolours the interior tilesheets to a more natural colour palette
⋆ removes the purpley shadows from inside most buildings 
⋆ cleans up the bathhouse so it no longer looks dirty/abandoned
⋆ recolours default furniture, wallpaper, and flooring to match
⋆ is compatible with most other mods, including interior map edits



[img]https://i.imgur.com/QsemUE7.png[/img]﻿

[i]edit the [b]config.json[/b] file in the mod folder to customise options. all values are either "true" or "false"[/i]

⋆ ChangeInteriorLighting
⋆ RecolourFarmHouseFurniture
⋆ RecolourWallsAndFloors
⋆ RecolourCoopAndBarnTiles
⋆ RecolourBathHouseTiles



[img]https://i.imgur.com/1EhY4eo.png[/img]﻿

1. install SMAPI and Content Patcher
2. download this mod & extract [b][CP] DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/b] folder to [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b]
3. run the game with SMAPI to play



[img]https://i.imgur.com/d4N1gzv.png[/img]
enjoy ♥
